title: Beyond the Single Turn: Reframing Refusals as Dynamic Experiences Embedded in the Context of Mental Health Support Interactions with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative thematic analysis of user surveys and interviews evaluating how generic wellness recommendations embedded in LLM safety refusals (e.g., suggesting a user 'take a walk outside') demonstrate ableism by ignoring the physical realities of disabled users.

Qualitative thematic analysis of user interviews examining how LLM intent recognition inappropriately triggers refusals for legitimate spiritual or religious inquiries by defaulting to Western normative frameworks.
